How does it build the BEV map?
1. Eight camera images
2. CNN features (RegNet + BiFPN)
3. Transformer turns 2D into 3D
4. Top-down 3D grid + memory
occupied
query cell
free space
1 Each cell is a spot on the road
2 It asks the cameras that see that spot
3 It remembers the last few frames
= occupied or free, every ~33 cm
Sources: Tesla patent application US 2025/0282344 (2025) · Li et al., BEVFormer, arXiv:2203.17270 · tesla.com/AI

Reality View
My own animation · Sources: Tesla’s CVPR 2022 talk · Tesla patent US 2025/0282344 · Not a Tesla App (Nov 2026)
How far away is that car?
Z = f × W ÷ w
f
1000 px · camera
W
1.5 m · real taillight gap
w
gap in pixels (measured)
Half the pixels = twice as far.
Animated example with illustrative numbers (f = 1,000 px, W = 1.5 m) · Pinhole camera model
Car far away, or motorcycle up close?
Same pixels, two answers
The camera can’t measure real size. It has to guess what it’s looking at.
2022 MOTORCYCLE CRASHES
Teslas on Autopilot hit motorcycles at night. One theory: this exact mix-up. Never confirmed.
Car? Lights 1.5 m apart: 1000 × 1.5 ÷ 30 = 50 m
Motorcycle? Lights 0.3 m apart: 1000 × 0.3 ÷ 30 = 10 m
Same image, same 30-px gap, f = 1,000 px (illustrative numbers) · Sources: Wikipedia, List of Tesla Autopilot crashes; RideApart (2022)

Where it still goes wrong
MAR 2025 · MARK ROBER TEST
Fog and heavy rain: no stop for the dummy. The lidar car stopped.
MAR 2026 · NHTSA
3.2 million cars, 9 crashes in glare, fog or dust. It didn’t notice it was blinded until just before the crash.
It has to know when it can’t see.
Sources: Tesla weather patent via Not a Tesla App (May 2026) · NHTSA PE24031 / EA26002 (Mar 2026) · Electrek (Mar 2025)

Where is radar used now?
“If lidars/radars disagree with cameras, which one wins?”
Elon Musk on X, August 2025, on why Tesla turned radar off
IN USE SINCE 2025
Cabin radar
Senses breathing through a car seat. Warns if a kid is left inside.
NEVER USED FOR FSD
Front HD radar
In some 2023–24 Model S and X. Never turned on for driving.
TEST CARS ONLY
Lidar
Test cars only. The new Cybercab: cameras only.
Radar is back, but only inside the cabin.
Sources: Not a Tesla App (Apr 2025, Feb 2026) · Tesla owner’s manual · TechCrunch (May 2024) · The Next Web (Jun 2026)
THE BET
Tesla is betting that enough data can teach cameras to see depth.
The open question: will the car always know when it can’t see?
Thank you. Questions?
